order_raw:
1. Complete lower-limb neurological examination, including tone, power, reflexes, sensation, coordination, and gait  
2. Hoover sign test  
3. Hip-abduction and abductor sign testing  
4. Straight-leg raise and crossed straight-leg raise tests  
5. Lumbar-spine and sacroiliac-joint examination  
6. MRI of the lumbar spine  
7. MRI of the brain with and without contrast
dx: Progressive degenerative cerebellar ataxia, most consistent with a hereditary spinocerebellar ataxia
